purpose: Portable deterministic workload contract for backend and rewrite comparisons.

embedding.vector_source: SHAKE256-seeded deterministic vectors precomputed before timing
embedding.encoding: little-endian uint32 samples mapped to [-1,1], L2-normalized, rounded to IEEE-754 float32

backend_matrix.sqlite_event_projection: SQLite authoritative events and projections; no semantic vector index, used as persistence baseline
backend_matrix.chroma_sqlite_metadata: Chroma PersistentClient vector collection and its SQLite metadata; Kogwistar app events/projections remain in SQLite
backend_matrix.postgres_pgvector: Kogwistar PgVectorBackend with cosine pgvector node index; Kogwistar app events/projections remain in SQLite

read_after_write.write_atomicity: one event plus one named projection in one transaction
read_after_write.visibility: both reads must observe the just-committed write

mixes.balanced: four graph reads per individually committed write; two readers observe before commit and two after commit
mixes.read_heavy: eight graph reads per individually committed write; all readers observe both before and after commit

concurrent.visibility: pre-commit reads observe the prior revision; post-commit reads observe the new revision; each observation has an exact revision bound

service_mode_scope.rust_native_jsonrpc_http_benchmark_slice: benchmark-only deterministic SQLite event/projection tool service; implements sequential and concurrent tools/call behavior; not the production Kogwistar MCP server
service_mode_scope.embedding_inference: excluded from timed sections; precomputed normalized vectors are used for backend runs

operation_contract.write_record: append one canonical entity event and atomically replace its projection
operation_contract.read_event: read the expected entity event by namespace and sequence
operation_contract.read_projection: read the expected named projection by namespace and key
operation_contract.vector_upsert: persist one precomputed normalized vector outside timed model inference; vector commit is measured separately from SQLite event/projection commit
operation_contract.vector_query: query deterministic sampled revisions; each query must return the expected record as cosine top-1

vector_query_sampling.schedule: evenly spaced deterministic indexes including first and final record
vector_query_sampling.reason: avoid accidental quadratic nearest-neighbor validation work as fixture size grows
